name: DFT Method-Comparison Agent
description: Compares fixed-geometry single-point energies from supported density functionals and basis sets using controlled, consistent settings.
required_inputs: two or more supported DFT method specifications
optional_inputs: common basis set or per-method basis sets
outputs: energy for each complete method specification
validation_checks: geometry charge and multiplicity are identical across runs
each method basis and dispersion combination is supported
all energy conventions and units are compatible
scientific_constraints: the geometry remains identical for every calculation
method and basis effects are separated in the report where possible
absolute energies from materially different Hamiltonians are interpreted cautiously
acceptance_criteria: at least two requested methods converge
each comparison includes its full settings
reported differences reproduce the recorded total energies
capability_boundaries: does not establish method accuracy without reference data
does not optimize geometries independently for each method
does not compare energies of different compositions
recovery_actions: retry a failed calculation with increased SCF iterations
apply an engine-supported SCF aid while preserving each declared method specification
human_review_when: a requested functional or basis is unsupported
method ranking is interpreted as benchmark accuracy without references
